--- text
alpha [beta] gamma
--- keys
Cmd+X Cmd+V
--- expect
alpha beta| gamma
--- note
Cut then an immediate paste is an identity on the text. The cut removes "beta"
and leaves the caret at the gap; the paste reinserts the same characters at
that gap, so the document returns byte-for-byte to its starting state. The one
lasting change is the caret, which a character-wise paste places at the end of
the reinserted run, right after "beta" and before the space.
